newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian stock prices fall further, Unibanka stable.
newsitem.headline: Latvian stock prices fall further, Unibanka stable.

text.p: Most Latvian stocks lost further ground on Monday although market leader Unibanka remained stable, dealers said.
Total market turnover came to 170,000 lats versus 142,000 lats yesterday and commercial bank indices fell.
Rietumu Bank's Rietumu index was down 0.56 percent to 228,85 and Saules Bank's Saule10 was 0.57 lower at 199,23.
Unibanka maintained its position at 4.95 lats as it turned over 29,700 lats.

Secondary list share Daugavpils Chain fell 10 santimes to 2.70 lats on turnover of 20,300 lats but Valmiera Glassfibre was among the day's few gainers. It advanced two santimes to 2.20 lats and had volume of 16,600 lats.
Kaija fish cannery closed five santimes down at 2.30 lats and saw turnover of 58,000 lats, the bourse's biggest today.
Other official list shares closed down.
Staburadze edged down a notch to 2.90 lats from 2.91 on volume of 10,000 lats and Riga Transport Fleet fell two santimes to 1.67 lats. It saw 4,100 lats of shares change hands.
Elsewhere on the secondary list Lode Brick maker fell seven santimes to 2.29 lats on turnover of 2,000 lats and Mangali Shipyard remained stable at 1.50 lats. It had volume of 5,300 lats.
